text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Once again— excellent work on the 
construction plans for the deserted island 
project!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Even so, it's not over yet!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
We must repeatedly conduct Island Training 
and prove its usefulness...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
You should definitely join in too! Aside 
from recruiting testers, I want you to 
push hard in the island training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the schedule, we should be able 
to do it twice. Let's find the right time 
and do some island training!
